description: Quiet short click — low-key UI tap / soft selection. Short accent, sync exactly to the on-screen action.
Punchy whoosh/impact — fast reveal or hard transition accent. Sync to the motion.
Quick pop — element appear/spawn, chip/tag/badge in. Small precise accent, sync to the pop-in.
Long cinematic riser (~10s build, peak at the end). Trigger at (climax_time − 10.03s) so it crests exactly on the reveal.
Single key press — one keystroke / terminal-input beat. Short accent, sync to the typed character.
Negative / error tone — failure state, a 'wrong' beat, or a glitchy interruption.
